question: Should this report become a separate OpenClaw runtime issue for missing pending-code creation, or be folded into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87506?
rationale: The reports overlap in Feishu pairing authorization but fail at different stages: the existing OpenClaw report successfully approves a new code, while this report cannot find the pending code. Runtime-domain judgment is needed before treating them as one defect.

options.title: Request separate runtime report
options.body: Preserve the missing-pending-code symptom separately and request synchronized request-creation and approval logs from the same profile and account.

options.title: Fold into existing runtime issue
options.body: Combine the reports only if runtime owners confirm that both failures come from the same account-scoped pairing-store contract.

recommendation.title: Request separate runtime report
recommendation.body: Preserve the missing-pending-code symptom separately and request synchronized request-creation and approval logs from the same profile and account.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available ClawHub-side routing candidate from recent package and CLI history, although the implementation owner is likely in the OpenClaw runtime repository.
